scenes.text: Imagine falling through a giant hole in the Earth and landing inside a secret ancient forest.
In 2022, scientists in China discovered a massive sinkhole over six hundred feet deep.
They found an entire untouched ecosystem with trees reaching one hundred feet tall, some growing as high as the shoulders of the explorers.
Because this deep world has been isolated for thousands of years, scientists believe there are completely new, undiscovered species living down there.
